items.a: Yes. First Time Heroes is the 12-week first-race route; Gym Confidence is the 6-week route for building the basics first. Both applications are linked here.

items.a: Use Find a Race-mate to post your division and pace. Cards are reviewed before they appear publicly; contact details stay private.
